_about: Every word the page shows that is not mission text (missions.json) or a uniform's name (uniforms.json). Keys named in the core's HUD (prompts, toasts with @, said_key) are looked up here.
title: Gatecrasher
subtitle: A third-person stealth game. You are Big Chum, the legendary soldier every soldier on the island dreams of serving with. One outpost, two portals, one silenced pistol, and the Memphis Mule.
credit: Art drawn in TikZ. Sound synthesized in the browser. The page loads only its own files.
no_webgl: This browser has no WebGL 2, so the game cannot draw. Try a current Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
uniform_note: How well each uniform blends into each ground, in camo index points. Change uniform in the field with U.
cause_shot: Shot. One bullet is all it takes.
cause_fell: A fall from that height kills.
kill_cost: A soldier killed: −{} points. Big Chum brings people home.
graceland_lead: Your base. Every soldier here hated the outpost and jumped at the chance to serve with Big Chum: the balloon is how they leave, and the first thing each one does on landing is say thank you. The more staff, and the better, the more each unit gives you on the next mission.
roster_empty: Nobody yet. Knock a soldier out, then press G beside him outdoors.
intel_none: Nothing yet. Grab a soldier from behind (F) and press E, hold one up at gunpoint (aim at him close up), or tie one to the mule (Y) and press E.
riding: Riding: you can be seen and heard from far off. J: get down
mule_full: The mule is already carrying someone.
grace_on_mule: Grace is on the mule. He'll carry him out.
use_talk_mule: E: interrogate the man on the mule
use_stash: E: put him in the locker
hold_options: F: choke out   X: kill   C: throw down
held_up_keep: Hands up: keep your gun on him (right mouse). E: interrogate   F: grab
hanging: Hanging: A/D shimmy along   W or Space: climb up   C: let go
charges_all: All four charges set. Get at least 70 m clear of the Deterrence Unit, then set them off.
sab_charges: Charges set: {} of 4. The sites are marked.
sab_clear: Charges set. Get {} m further from the Deterrence Unit to set them off safely.
sab_go: Clear of the blast. E: set off the charges.
sab_hold: Hold out: the helicopter lands in {} s.
sab_heli: The helicopter is down. Get to the landing zone.
sab_blown: The Deterrence Unit is down. The whole base is out looking for you. Hold out for the helicopter.
heli_coming: Pilot: "Big Chum, I see the smoke. Coming in."
heli_down: Pilot: "On the ground at the landing zone. Move!"
lz_not_done: The helicopter will not come until the objective is done.
held_up: "Don't shoot! Don't shoot!" (He drops his rifle.)
prisoner_out: Grace is on his way home.
radio_woke: Radio: "HQ, I was knocked out. Someone's inside the wire."
radio_held_up: Radio: "HQ, I was held up at gunpoint. Intruder inside the wire!"
radio_found: Radio: "Found one of ours out cold. Sweep the area."
radio_body: Radio: "Man down! We've got a body!"
portal_seen: An elite saw your portal and shut it.
mule_no_target: Point at a soldier for the mule to ram.
mule_far: The mule is too far away. Whistle for him (H).
tie_nothing: Nobody down to tie to the mule.
tie_ready: Y: tie him to the mule
tie_grace: Y: put Grace on the mule
tie_far: Y: call the mule over to tie him on
untie: Y: take him off the mule
untie_grace: Y: take Grace off the mule
mule_coming: The mule is coming. Press Y again when he's beside you.
tied_on: Tied to the mule. E: interrogate him.
fulton_roof: No sky here: a balloon needs open air.
controls: Crouch / stand (crouch-walking is silent); let go of a ledge
Vault (over low things on the move), leap and hang from a ledge, climb up; dive (sprinting, knocks a soldier down); stand up
Aim (hold on a soldier to mark him; close up, he puts his hands up)
CQC: grab from behind, or disarm and throw from the front
Use: pick up, put down, lockers, cage, case, charges, detonator; interrogate (in a hold, held up, pinned at gunpoint, or on the mule)
Mule: ram the soldier you point at
Put a downed soldier, or Grace, on the mule; or take him off
Ride the mule, or get down (fast, but very noticeable)
